task.task_name: Integrate CLI relay transport and durable send retry
task.description: Implement the strict relay client and outbound messenger APIs declared by the independently authored nine-test RED suite.
acceptance_criteria: RelayClient uses bounded requests, strict schemas, stable redacted typed errors, and exact documented endpoint bodies.
Outbound publish exports the complete local signed bundle v2.
First send claims using a durable id, verifies the returned bundle against all contact pins and official Signal signatures, establishes the trusted session, and sends a valid mailbox envelope.
The encrypted store durably retains immutable message content identity, exact ciphertext/envelope bytes, and pending/delivered state.
Timeout and restart retry the exact serialized send body without a second claim or new IDs.
Changed plaintext under the same message_id fails locally; identical delivered replay performs no network call.
All nine supplied T24 tests and all prior workspace tests/typechecks pass without weakening assertions.
task.context: Implement the exact public APIs used in relayClient.test.ts and outbound.test.ts. Use SignalClient.retry for durable ciphertext replay and importVerifiedSignalBundleV2 for native verification. Compare claimed identity_id, device_id, device_pubkey and signal_identity_key with the imported contact before establish. Derive recipient mailbox ID with the existing crypto-core helper. Persist CLI outbox records under cli:outbox: inside EncryptedSqliteStore; keep exact serialized request bytes or an object whose JSON serialization is provably stable. Never include remote error messages, plaintext, ciphertext, secrets or request bodies in public errors/diagnostics. Repository is unborn main; do not commit.
task.module_patterns: ESM strict TypeScript, Zod strict schemas, injected fetch/clock/id factories, real encrypted SQLite and official libsignal, colocated Vitest.

test_case_specs.run_command: cd apps/cli && pnpm exec vitest run src/transport/relayClient.test.ts src/runtime/outbound.test.ts
